mode: live capture, captured-table replay, live unpivot only
research_context: Randomized trials of immune checkpoint inhibitors for unresectable stage III or IV malignant melanoma; efficacy, survival, tumor response, and tolerability outcomes.

excluded.table_2: eligibility criteria are review-level prose and outside the selected comparison scope
excluded.table_5: risk-of-bias symbols are not Phase 6B target claims
excluded.table_6: graph was transcribed into estimated percentages; shape errors and non-verbatim values make it inadmissible

limitations: The current table capturer does not capture forest plots; HR/CI rows are manually frozen ground truth and should expose that parser gap.
Only Larkin 2015 has a locally frozen source PDF in Phase 6A.
Live model output is not a deterministic regression baseline.
The current numeric schema does not represent the confidence level (95% versus 99.5%); two natural mismatch rows are expected to expose this gap.
